name: secondbrain-skills
description: Self-contained Agent Skills for Obsidian vaults: native Obsidian packages and knowledge packages, including principles. This is a public prerelease; runtime loads are unverified.

interface.shortDescription: Independent Agent Skills for Obsidian vaults: native Obsidian and knowledge packages.
interface.longDescription: The secondbrain-skills collection holds native Obsidian packages, knowledge task packages and independently usable principles; each package owns exactly its named feature and requires no sibling. This plugin is a distribution container, not a router, dispatcher, or shared runtime. This is a public prerelease; runtime loads are unverified.
